focusedFinal.note: Rerun after improving the assertion to inspect the original document negative-zero value directly.

limits: Windows x64 source Electron comparison, two fresh processes per condition, two unchanged PIV exports per process, control/candidate/candidate/control order. Not a cross-platform or installer certification.
Only backend/server.py differs in benchmark runtime sources. Fixtures and request bytes match; all eight PIV exports match original source bytes.
Other workstation activity, OS caches and CPU frequency are uncontrolled. Variation in unchanged stages prevents attributing the entire total latency difference to this optimization.

The final isolated decoded-source sample shows no reliable speed gain and measures different numeric types than the submitted JS JSON. Preliminary samples and diagnostic profiles are not substituted for that result.
No allocation or memory reduction is claimed for scalar dispatch. The existing per-frame temporary-memory regression test passes.
Verification tasks ran after timing samples; their browser timings are correctness evidence only.

One attempted exact-control reconstruction failed its source-hash guard before changing production bytes or launching Electron; the eventual control was reconstructed and verified byte-for-byte before its run.
